title: Juice

{{Infobox |eng = Juice |source = [[Artisan Goods]] |sellprice = 2.25 × Base [[Vegetables|Vegetable]] / [[Foraging#Foraged Items|Forage]] Price |ingredients = Any [[Vegetables|vegetable]] (1) (other than [[Wheat]], [[Hops]], & [[Tea Leaves]]) ''or''
Any positive energy [[Foraging#Foraged Items|foraged item]] (1) (other than [[:Category:Mushrooms|Mushrooms]]) |craftingstation = {{Name|Keg}} |crafttime = 6000m (≈4d) |quality = false }} {{For|a detailed analysis of profit using the Keg|Keg Productivity}} '''Juice''' is an [[Artisan Goods|Artisan Good]] made from placing a [[Vegetables|vegetable]] or [[Foraging#Foraged Items|foraged item]] inside a [[Keg]], taking approximately 4 [[Day Cycle|days]]. Its selling price is the base value of the ingredient input multiplied by 2.25 (3.15 with the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan]] profession). The [[energy]] and [[health]] restored by Juice is equal to 2 × Base Ingredient Value for edible vegetables and foraged items. For inedible vegetables, Juice will restore energy equal to exactly Base [[vegetables|Vegetable]] Value and health equal to 45% Base [[vegetables|Vegetable]] Value. The color of the Juice also depends on the item used. Although [[Wheat]], [[Hops]], and [[Tea Leaves]] are classified as [[vegetables]], when used with a [[Keg]], they produce [[Beer]], [[Pale Ale]], and [[Green Tea]] respectively. The following foraged items can be made into Juice: [[Cave Carrot]], [[Dandelion]], [[Ginger]], [[Hazelnut]], [[Leek]], [[Spring Onion]], [[Snow Yam]], [[Wild Horseradish]], and [[Winter Root]]. Juice cannot be put in a [[cask]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jodi,Kent,Sam,Leah,Shane,Marnie,Elliott,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Harvey,Sandy,Willy,Krobus,Leo |hate=Sebastian,Jas,Vincent }} ==Bundles== Juice is one of the options for the {{bundle|brewers||y}}. ==Recipes== Juice is not used in any recipes. ==Tailoring== Juice is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[File:Shirt209.png|24px]] [[Tailoring|Sports Shirt]]. It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== *[[Pam]] requests 12 Potato Juice in the [[Quests#The Strong Stuff|"The Strong Stuff"]] Special Order. *One Juice is requested by the Raccoon at the [[Giant Stump]] as part of his fourth request. It may also be requested as part of any request starting with the sixth. ==Trivia== Juice sold by the [[Traveling Cart]] will not be of any ingredients type, will sell for {{Price|150}} (or {{Price|210}} with the [[Skills#Farming|Artisan Profession]]), and will restore 75 [[energy]] and 33 [[health]]. ==References== See ObjectDataDefinition::CreateFlavoredJuice in the game code. ==History== {{History|1.4|Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].}} {{History|1.5|Is now an option in the Brewer's Bundle.}} {{History|1.6|Inventory icon changed, it is no longer a recolor of the Wine sprite. The new Juice icon now changes color to match the item used to create it. Positive energy Forage can now be made into Juice.
